reply.text: This sounds like a question about how your shoulders feel, and that is one for a doctor or physio, not a coach, so I won't weigh in on what's going on in them. If you want to keep going on the training side, I can look at your bench numbers and your program with you, and we can talk through how a swap like that would fit the week once you've got the go-ahead from someone who can assess it.
